request_summary: Install the table dependency, take a read-only before snapshot of the shared issuer table, then rerun the GEC suite on DEV to verify issuer setup and restore.

actions.description: Installed the approved package version in the run interpreter and read the configured issuer table in the three fixture partitions before launching; the read failed with table not found, so the runner stopped and reported blocked without starting behave.

The orchestrator compared the configured table name with the oracle environment files: the name matches the AFM storage account naming, while the endpoint used for the override belongs to a different storage account.

outcome.detail: The runner correctly stopped at the failed read-only precondition; no test ran and no remote state was changed, and the endpoint used for the override appears to be the wrong storage account.

friction.description: The runner changed the approved read target by using the table name from configuration instead of the default name mentioned in the plan; it was disclosed and was the correct reading of the configuration.
